q: Do I need a carbon baseline before applying for a green loan?
title: Carbon baseline before a green loan
short: It helps. A baseline of twelve months of energy use, fuel and production shows where you start, so the project's effect can be estimated and later checked. Some lenders ask for it; even where they do not, it makes the case clearer.
audience: MSMEs preparing a green loan or sustainability-linked loan application

ul: Twelve months of electricity bills and fuel invoices.
Emissions and intensity per unit, with factors stated.

p: Compare the baseline with the project's expected savings, labelled as an estimate, and repeat the measurement after commissioning.
Missing months and unrecorded diesel are the usual problems; fill them before applying.

senseible: Senseible turns bills and fuel invoices into a dated, traceable emissions record, the kind of evidence lenders may ask for. Lenders decide, and financing is never guaranteed.
